responsibility: Defines small shared Arm/AArch64 backend types for option parsing and branch protection. In particular it provides the parse-result enum used by common architecture/feature option parsers, enums describing return-address signing scope and key selection, and the descriptor structure used to represent branch-protection tokens and subtypes for the shared -mbranch-protection parser.
same_name_distinction: Defines the shared Arm/AArch64 option-parsing and branch-protection data types used by aarch-common.cc, rather than implementing the scheduling/RTL helpers or the branch-protection parsing logic itself.
